answers.tankbuster: Top the tank off in advance
answers.dispel.poison: Party member who can cleanse poison
answers.dispel.disease: Party member who can cleanse disease
answers.freedom: Party member who can remove roots/snares

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Top the party before Ravenous Stomp's party damage, and heal players stunned by stalactites first
[광역 피해] During Ssscavenging, Carrion Burst repeats until the shield breaks, so use AoE healing cooldowns here
[참고] If the boss eats a Fresh Meat pile, Feeding Frenzy makes Carrion Burst tick faster, so have an extra AoE healing cooldown ready
[해제] Regurgitate is a disease. Remove the 50% movement speed and damage reduction from hit players with a disease dispel
The Writhing Coil: [광역 피해] Synchronized Venom deals nature damage to the whole party every second for 35s and its tooltip lists no dispel type, so outlast it with steady AoE healing
[광역 피해] Death Rattle party damage ramps until the tethers break, so if they break late, start AoE healing early
[해제] When the Spiteful Hunt target is hit by a Writhe, Spiteful Venom poison stacks; cleanse it with a poison dispel
[차단] Healers with an interrupt join the Toxic Atrophy rotation when the 3-kick order is short
Zul'jan: [광역 피해] Use an AoE healing cooldown on every 8s Ritual of the Fang channel. Beams reaching the boss grant Fang Empowered, stacking party damage
[참고] Ritual Venom's tooltip lists no dispel type, so don't dispel it; spot-heal the initial hit and 7s physical DoT on players who clear it with Boneslicer
[탱버] Top the tank right after the Chop Down double hit
[위치] If a healer has a beam spot, be in position before the channel, and drop Bloodletting blood pools at the edge

Lightblossom Trinity: [탱버] Bedrock Slam deals heavy Nature and Physical damage to the tank, so top the tank for the cast
[광역 피해] On Mythic, Bedrock Surge follows Bedrock Slam with an 8s party-wide DoT, so prepare AoE healing
[광역 피해] Lightbloom Overgrowth's 8s AoE damage scales with the flowers' Light-Gorged stacks, so if any beams were missed, use an AoE healing cooldown here
[위치] Heal from outside Fertile Loam and Light-Scorched Earth, and spread if targeted by Thornblade
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [광역 피해] Thorncaller Roar deals Nature damage to the whole party for 6s, so use an AoE healing cooldown and call for personal defensives
[광역 피해] After 50%, Lightcrazed Frenzy deals Holy AoE damage every 2s until it dies, so save big healing cooldowns for this phase
[해제] Bloodthorn Roots is a magic effect per its tooltip. Free rooted allies with a magic dispel so they're ready for Bloodthirsty Gaze and Verdant Stomp
[회피] If you're the Bloodthirsty Gaze target, keep distance from the boss for 10s and heal on the move
Lightwarden Ruia: [탱버] In Bear Form, Mangling Claws doubles melee damage, so increase healing on the tank
[참고] Grievous Thrash is a stacking bleed that only drops at full health, so heal affected players to 100%
[광역 피해] After 40%, every ability comes every 8s during Spirits of the Vale, so save AoE healing cooldowns for this phase
[회피] Lightfire Beams silence for 6s and cut off your healing, so always dodge them
Ziekket: [광역 피해] Oozing Xylem deals Holy damage to the whole party every 3s the entire fight, so keep steady AoE healing going
[참고] Players who step on many Lightbloom's Essence orbs stack a 12s Holy DoT, so heal them first
[탱버] Thornspike leaves a 10s physical bleed on the tank, so keep the knocked-back tank within range
[회피] Lightsap puddles slow by 40% and disrupt healer positioning, so get out right away

The Hoardmonger: [광역 피해] Ravenous Bellow is armor-ignoring physical damage to everyone plus a 10s DoT, so use an AoE healing cooldown
[참고] Hearty Bellow (after it eats meat) adds a knockback, so hold heal casts until after the knockback
[해제] Each Spoiled Supplies mushroom stacks Toxic Spores poison, so cleanse players with the most stacks first
[위치] Healers also share mushroom soaks; if it eats the mushroom pile and the count goes up, spread wider
Sentinel of Winter: [해제] Glacial Torment is a 16s frost DoT and a magic effect. Remove it with a magic dispel
[광역 피해] Missed Winter's Shroud casts deal frost damage to everyone and stack frost damage taken, so prepare AoE healing
[광역 피해] During the party-wide Frozen Tempest DoT, AoE heal from inside a Snowdrift. Inside a Snowdrift you're slowed by 40%
[회피] Raging Squall tornadoes deal heavy damage and knock back, so prioritize moving over casting heals
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] Overwhelming Onslaught's three armor-ignoring physical hits still hurt behind Zul'jarra's shield, so use your AoE healing cooldown here and don't let the final hit's party knockback interrupt a channeled cooldown
[광역 피해] During Fury of the War God, plant in front of Zul'jarra and heal each player who takes Echoing Fury nature damage from blocking an Echo
[참고] Each Echo that reaches Zul'jarra stacks 10% damage taken via Demoralizing Scream, so healing load grows with every missed Echo
[위치] During Overwhelming Onslaught, healers also stand behind Zul'jarra's shield to reduce damage by 80%

Kystia Manaheart: [해제] Corroding Spittle is a 30s magic DoT. Dispel low-health targets and players facing Mirror Images clones first
[광역 피해] During the 20s of Destabilized, Chaos damage hits the whole party every second, so line up an AoE healing cooldown with every window
[탱버] Chaos Barrage hits the tank first and bounces to nearby party members, so heal melee near the tank as well
[회피] When Kystia teleports and casts Fel Nova, healers also get out of range
Zaen Bladesorrow: [해제] Heartstop Poison on the tank after Envenom is a poison that reduces max health by 30% and deals Nature damage for 15s, so cleanse it with a poison dispel
[광역 피해] Killing Spree is armor-ignoring party AoE damage, so use an AoE healing cooldown if it overlaps the Fel-Infused Freight DoT
[참고] Players hit by Murder in a Row take heavy damage and a 15s bleed, so spot-heal them right away
[위치] During Murder in a Row, healers also take a barrel and hide behind Forbidden Freight
Xathuux the Annihilator: [탱버] Legion Strike reduces healing taken by 80% for 8s, so top the tank before the cast and prepare an external defensive
[광역 피해] Prepare AoE healing for Infernal Crush. If an Axe Toss axe is alive, stacking Fel Lightning damage is added
[광역 피해] AoE damage lands when the Demonic Rage cast ends, so top the party before then
[회피] Heal while staying spread and dodging Burning Steps puddles
Lithiel Cinderfury: [광역 피해] Searing Fel Flame deals constant damage to the party the whole fight, so keep steady AoE healing going
[참고] A missed Chaos Bolt interrupt means heavy damage on a random target, so heal that target first
[참고] Players hit by Malefic Wave get a DoT and 50% fire vulnerability, which also increases Searing Fel Flame damage, so prioritize spot-healing them
[위치] Once Malefic Wave has cleared the far end of the gate, take the Demonic Gateway with the party before the wave reaches you, to stay in healing range

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Dark Bloom deals heavy shadow damage to the whole party, so line up an AoE healing cooldown with it
[광역 피해] Top the party before Umbral Rupture. Players within 10 yards of a Void Fissure take damage
[탱버] Void Blast is tank damage with a knockback, so stay in healing range while the tank circles along the wall
[회피] Orbs flying out of Void Fissures are lethal, so prioritize dodging over healing
Atroxus: [광역 피해] After Monstrous Roar's party physical damage, the Toxic Creeper's Toxic Aura ticks every 0.5s, so use AoE healing cooldowns while the Creeper is alive
[탱버] Hulking Claw is heavy nature damage plus a 10s nature DoT. Sickening Bite stacks increase the tank's nature damage taken, so top them before the cast and prepare an external defensive
[해제] Mind-Numbing Poison from Poison Splash and Poison Pool is a poison. It cuts haste by 30% and slows healing, so cleanse it; Sickening Bite can't be dispelled
[회피] Dodge the Noxious Breath frontal and stand beside the boss
Charonus: [광역 피해] Unstable Singularity deals DoT damage to the whole party the entire fight, so keep steady AoE healing going
[광역 피해] Use AoE healing cooldowns for Cosmic Crash's burst and 20s DoT
[참고] Gravitic Orbs targets stack the Condensed Mass shadow DoT, so spot-heal them until the orb is gone
[회피] Touching a Singularity applies Atomized, blocking healing for 15s, so never go in

The Golden Serpent: [광역 피해] Assign AoE healing cooldowns to Serpentine Gust's AoE damage and knockback
[참고] Spit Gold's 6s fire DoT hits hard, so spot-heal the targets
[탱버] Top the tank for Tail Thrash
[위치] Don't stand with your back to Molten Gold pools so the Serpentine Gust knockback doesn't push you in
Mchimba the Embalmer: [광역 피해] Awakening Slam is heavy party AoE damage, so prepare an AoE healing cooldown or burst healing
[참고] Drain Fluids targets get Desiccation after the big hit, which only drops above 90% health, so top them first
[해제] Wretched Discharge is a disease. If a missed interrupt lets it land, remove it with a disease dispel
[참고] If a healer is trapped by Entomb, spam Struggle so the party finds the crypt quickly
The Council of Tribes: [참고] Kula's Severing Axe target takes heavy damage and an 8s bleed, so spot-heal them
[탱버] After Aka'ali's Debilitating Backhand, Shattered Defenses increases the tank's physical damage taken by 200%, so increase tank healing
[해제] A missed Zanazal Poison Nova interrupt puts a 12s poison DoT on everyone, so cleanse it with a poison dispel or outheal it with AoE healing
[위치] During Barrel Through, healers also stack within 7 yards of the target to soak. It keeps coming even after Aka'ali dies
Dazar, The First King: [광역 피해] Gilded Destruction is the hardest-hitting part, with burst AoE damage followed by a 15s party DoT, so line up big healing cooldowns with it
[탱버] After 80%, T'zala's Savage Maul (bleed and vulnerability) is followed immediately by Blade Combo, so prepare an external defensive for the tank

[위치] Aerial Smash hits within 8 yards of impact, so spread; Quaking Leap hits the whole party with damage that falls off with distance from the landing spot, so keep the party topped through the 4 leaps
[회피] Watch the Impaling Spear floor pattern and move to a safe spot before the spears land

Melidrussa Chillworn: [광역 피해] Chillstorm deals frost damage to everyone every 1.5s and explodes after 7s, so top the party before the explosion and use an AoE healing cooldown while the storm is up
[광역 피해] Frost Overload in the 66/33% intermissions deals party damage every 1.5s and stacks increased damage taken, so use an AoE healing cooldown here
[해제] Cold Claws from intermission Infused Whelps is a magic effect that stacks on the tank and becomes Frozen Solid at 20 stacks, so watch the tank's stacks and magic-dispel them before 20
[회피] Touching Hailbombs ice cuts haste by 50% and slows your healing, so don't step on it
Kokia Blazehoof: [탱버] Each Searing Blows hit stacks a Searing Wounds fire DoT, so keep healing the tank and use an external defensive at high stacks
[광역 피해] Blazebound Firestorm's Inferno deals fire damage to everyone and stacks an 8s DoT, so prepare an AoE healing cooldown
[위치] When the Firestorm dies, Burnout deals heavy fire damage within 20 yards, so healers stand outside that range
[회피] Dodge the Molten Boulder path and the Scorched Earth on the floor
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [해제] The Stormslam debuff is a magic effect that increases the tank's nature damage taken by 100% for 30s and stacks, so magic-dispel it before the next Stormslam
[참고] Stop your heal casts before the 5s Interrupting Cloudburst cast ends to avoid the 2s lockout
[광역 피해] Phase 2 starts when either boss reaches 50% (Raider.IO: Erkhart at 40%), so stack your AoE healing cooldowns into this phase
[위치] If targeted by Inferno Spit, move outside the party and place the puddle based on the next Winds of Change direction

Adderis & Aspix: [참고] Aspix's Gust target takes burst nature damage and a 4s DoT, so focus-heal them
[광역 피해] Thunder and Lightning is split right after the Gale Force knockback, so top the party before then
[광역 피해] After Adderis dies, Aspix's Frenzy speeds up its ability timers, so save AoE healing cooldowns for this phase
[탱버] Top the tank for Adderis's Overload
Merektha: [광역 피해] Use major AoE healing cooldowns for Serpentstorm's AoE damage
[탱버] Lightning Bite is heavy physical damage plus a 7s nature DoT, so be ready to heal the tank every time
[해제] Toxic Viper's Poison Spit is an 8s poison DoT. If an interrupt is missed, cleanse it with a poison dispel
[회피] The Burrow charge stuns, so get out of the dust trail
Galvazzt: [참고] Players blocking Lightning Spire beams take nature damage every 0.5s from Galvanized, so focus-heal the soakers
[광역 피해] Top the party before Induction's party AoE damage
[참고] Healers also rotate into the beam soak, so plan the rotation with your DPS around your own defensives and healing cooldowns
Avatar of Sethraliss: [참고] While the Essence Defiler is alive, Defiling Taint blocks external healing on the Avatar, so focus on healing the party then
[참고] After the Essence Defiler dies, the fight ends once the healer heals the Avatar to 100% within 30s, so dump your healing cooldowns on the Avatar in this window
[위치] Faithless Tormentors fixate the healer and apply Shadowlash in melee range, so keep your distance while healing the Avatar. The party handles CC and kills
[참고] When Latent Hex expires, shadow damage and Hex Muck hit within 10 yards of the target, so make sure the target has moved to the back edge of the room
